Subject: Post-call recap + next step: relink meeting & pick deep-dive slot

Thanks again for the call earlier — really useful to hear about Farmlytics' inference constraints and production priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Discovery highlights: primary workloads are batch scoring for nightly jobs (~10M tokens/day) and a low-latency inference path for the user-facing web UI (p90 < 250ms).
- Main risks to validate in a technical deep-dive: tail latency under burst, model quantization impact on AUC, and network egress patterns for VPC deployment.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with our infra SEs (walkthrough of a small proof-of-concept and quantization options). I tried to send a calendar invite when we hung up but wanted to check whether you received it — sometimes invites mis-route across domains/timezones.

Please pick any of these windows (all in PST):
- Wed Oct 28, 10:00–11:00 PST
- Wed Oct 28, 14:00–15:00 PST
- Thu Oct 29, 09:00–10:00 PST

If the invite didn't arrive for you, use this quick poll so we can lock a time: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd-1234-deepdive (I've also pasted an alternate join link below in case calendar invites get lost).

Proposed agenda (60m):
1) 10m — brief intro + success metrics
2) 30m — architecture & POC constraints (SE-led)
3) 15m — quantization/cost tradeoffs
4) 5m — next steps / owners

Can you confirm the attendees from your side (we expect product + infra; please add a security contact if you'll need SOC2/KMS details)?

Alternate join URL (Zoom): https://redwood.zoom.us/j/876543210

Thanks — I'll cc Monica to own the deep-dive logistics.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Quick note from me — great call yesterday. For the deep-dive, would recommend we prioritize:
- concrete latency targets + trace of a single request path during burst (helps sizing and routing policy)
- quantization delta checks on a small eval set (we can run live during the call)
- clear rollback plan if a quantized model shows regressions

I'll be available to hop on for the first 15m to align on success criteria and backstop any procurement questions. Monica, please confirm the POC artifacts you'll need from Farmlytics ahead of time (sample payload size, seq lengths, and a small eval set).

—Ben
